{{- /* Root llms.txt: an INDEX, not a dump. Each top-level section renders
   through utils/llms-index-tree.html, which links every version to its own
   llms.txt (latest first), caps leaf sections such as a blog at
   site.Params.llms.leafPageLimit entries, and never inlines a full docs tree.
   No build timestamp: it changed every llms.txt on every build, which made
   byte-identical comparisons of two builds impossible. */ -}}
{{- $prodHost := partial "utils/prod-host.html" . -}}
{{- $body := "" -}}
{{- range partial "utils/llms-children.html" . -}}
  {{- $body = print $body (partial "utils/llms-index-tree.html" (dict "page" . "level" 2 "prodHost" $prodHost)) -}}
{{- end -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}
{{ with .Site.Params.description }}
> {{ . }}
{{ end }}
This is the root documentation index. For detailed page listings, follow the section links below.
